changelog:
Initial release—deploy, mint, and trade autonomous SRC-20 tokens on SynapticChain Layer-1 in one step.

- Enables permissionless creation and deployment of custom SRC-20 tokens via a single command.
- Supports key token operations: transfer, balanceOf, approve, transferFrom.
- Optimized for 256-lane parallel execution.
- Provides RPC endpoint and block explorer integration.
summary: Deploy, mint, and trade autonomous SRC-20 tokens on SynapticChain Layer-1 in a single command.
